description.value: California Thai is a Thai fusion chain offering dishes such as Pad Thai, curries, noodle soups, and fried rice across mall food-court locations. The brand is built around Thai culinary philosophy, emphasizing harmonious teamwork and rich fusion flavours. The chain's official website lists no British Columbia locations, making the existence of this Tsawwassen listing difficult to verify.
